description: Powerful 350W Motor – 36V hub motor delivers strong, consistent power with top speeds up to 19 MPH for thrilling mini bike rides. Long-Lasting Lithium Battery – 36V 7800mAh Li-ion battery provides reliable performance and extended ride time on every charge. Twist-Grip Throttle – Motorcycle-style control with power button integrated into the twist grip for easy, responsive acceleration. Durable Steel Frame – Sturdy red steel construction with black accents is built for stability, strength, and long-lasting fun. Confident Braking – Rear disc brake ensures quick, reliable stopping power so every ride stays safe and controlled.
